name: gm-tools
description: Root package for GM_Tools shared library code (mutation-engine/, time-skip/, graph-import/) — pure Node modules with no Foundry or MCP-session dependency. wf-mcp-server keeps its own package.json/node_modules for MCP-specific deps; this root exists so mutation-engine/ can resolve zod and @anthropic-ai/sdk without living inside wf-mcp-server.
